name: Logitech G840 XL Cloth Gaming Mouse Pad
description: The Logitech G840 XL is an extended cloth mouse pad sized to fit both mouse and full keyboard, offering a smooth micro-textured surface for consistent glide. A rubberized base keeps it anchored during intense gaming sessions, while reinforced stitched edges prevent fraying over time.

name: Razer Goliathus Extended Chroma
description: The Razer Goliathus Extended Chroma combines a woven micro-weave cloth surface with full-length underglow RGB lighting synced through Razer Chroma. Its extended size covers both mouse and keyboard, giving desk setups a cohesive, illuminated aesthetic without sacrificing tracking consistency.

name: SteelSeries QcK Heavy
description: The SteelSeries QcK Heavy is a thick, non-slip cloth mouse pad renowned for its consistent tracking surface trusted by professional gamers for over a decade. Its rubber base and durable stitched edges ensure it stays flat and intact through years of daily use.

name: Corsair MM350 Premium Spill-Proof Cloth
description: The Corsair MM350 features a spill-proof, water-resistant surface designed for durability under intense use, with anti-fray stitched edges and a non-slip rubber base. Its extended size accommodates a full keyboard and mouse for a clean, unified desk layout.

name: Glorious XXL Extended Mouse Mat
description: The Glorious XXL Extended Mouse Mat covers an entire desk surface with a stitched, high-quality cloth top optimized for both high and low DPI tracking. Its heavy-duty rubber base resists curling and sliding, making it a favorite among enthusiast desk-setup builders.

name: HyperX Fury S Pro
description: The HyperX Fury S Pro offers a densely woven cloth surface engineered for balanced control and speed, with a natural rubber base that grips the desk securely. Stitched edges add durability for gamers who want consistent performance session after session.

name: ASUS ROG Sheath BLK LTD
description: The ASUS ROG Sheath BLK LTD is an extended-size gaming mat with a smooth cloth surface tuned for precise cursor control at any sensitivity setting. Anti-fray stitched borders and a non-slip rubber base ensure it stays put through extended gaming marathons.

name: Zowie G-SR-SE
description: The Zowie G-SR-SE is a control-type cloth mouse pad designed and tested with professional CS players for maximum stopping precision during tactical aim. Its rigid, textured surface offers consistent glide resistance favored in high-level competitive play.

name: Artisan Hien Soft
description: The Artisan Hien Soft is a premium Japanese-made speed-type mouse pad known for its ultra-smooth glide and soft cushioned base. Popular among competitive FPS players for its silky surface texture, it's a favorite for players prioritizing fast flick-based aiming.

name: Pulsar ParaControl V2
description: The Pulsar ParaControl V2 blends control and speed characteristics in a hybrid weave surface, offering balanced glide resistance for varied playstyles. Its natural rubber base and precision-stitched edges give it long-term durability favored by enthusiast peripheral collectors.
